description: This file is a PHP source file for managing the behavior of the 'Merge Records' step in the SuiteCRM module. It handles the display and processing of record merging, including rendering fields for comparison and handling user interactions for selecting a primary record.

methods.name: display_field_value
methods.description: Truncates long field values for display and sets hover text with the full value.

methods.name: show_field
methods.description: Determines whether a given field should be included in the merge process based on its definition.

methods.name: get_related_name
methods.description: Fetches the related record's display name given field definitions and an ID value.
